old_label.reason: Section 17 is part of the same Delhi statutory scheme and regulates notice where a post-Act subletting occurred with previous written landlord consent, as well as notice for certain lawful pre-Act sublettings. The supplied record contains an allegation of subletting but no supplied fact establishing written consent or a section 17 notice. It therefore provides background concerning a potentially lawful notified subtenancy but does not itself decide whether section 14(1)(b)'s eviction ground is satisfied.
